title: airgap: slim offline index + sealed-bundle compatibility fallback and terraform registry policy
author: Evan Carlisle
release_notes: Adds a space-saving 'slim' OCI index generation mode for air-gapped installs, a sealed-bundle compatibility fallback path for older kubelet/kernel combos, Terraform registry policy module for mirror ACLs, and helm hook-driven automated rollback promotion.
description: Context: Large on-prem customers saw installer bundle sizes and prefetch times balloon when we included full OCI indexes plus heavy operator images. This caused prolonged pre-seed sync windows and occasional checksum mismatches on older k8s nodes. This PR implements a compact 'slim' offline index format plus a compatibility fallback for sealed bundles, improves Terraform registry mirror policy support, and adds a Helm hook-driven rollback promotion so an operator can gracefully revert to the previously sealed bundle on upgrade failures. Design summary: 1) Slim index generator emits a reduced manifest (content-addressed file list + layer pointers) and an optional delta map for clients to rehydrate full image indexes during install. The format is backwards-compatible: installer falls back to the full index when clients request it. 2) Sealed-bundle compatibility shim: when kubelet reports an older runtime or kernel feature set, the installer will mount an alternate layout and replicate a 'compat' manifest that strips problematic platform variants. 3) Terraform registry policy module: allows admins to specify ACLs (allowlist/denylist) for mirrored registries and a pre-seed ACL check that fails fast with a human-readable diff. 4) Helm rollback hooks: on canary/blue-green upgrades the chart now installs a pre-upgrade hook that snapshots the current sealed-bundle index and a post-failure hook that promotes the snapshot back to the active cache with consistent checksums and metrics emission. Checklist: - [x] Slim index generator (indexer CLI and Go lib) - [x] Installer runtime: detection and fallback logic - [x] Helm chart changes and hooks - [x] Terraform module and example usage - [x] Unit tests for index reader/writer - [x] Integration test with local registry mirror - [x] E2E airgap smoke test using k3s cluster image - [x] Docs: upgrade notes, preflight requirements Related work: builds on ENG-1423 (indexing refactor) and ENG-1802 (airgap prefetch improvements). Linear: ENG-1423, ENG-1802. Risks and mitigation: the slim index is an additional artifact; we guard by feature flag and default to legacy index until telemetry indicates >95% client support. Backward compatibility validated by integration against the last three installer releases. Manual testing: validated with customer mirror images for two large customers; no checksum mismatches observed after mesh hydration. Rollout plan: staged canary via Dedicated lab -> internal alpha customers -> opt-in for enterprise customers -> flip feature flag for general availability after 2 weeks of telemetry. Upgrade/rollback instructions: see release_notes and docs/airgap/upgrade-guide.md; brief path: snapshot current sealed bundle via helm hook, apply canary, if preflight/healthchecks fail run helm rollback which triggers promotion hook to restore snapshot. Observability: new metrics installer.index.slim_generated, installer.rollback.promotions, terraform.registry.acl_denies. Test plan: unit, integration, and an e2e airgap test added to perf-canary.
